derived_values.name: Trend buffer index 2
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(handle, buffer_index=2, SignalBar, 1) → Trend[0] with values +2 (strong bullish), +1 (mild bullish), -1 (mild bearish), -2 (strong bearish)

other_exits: Long position closed when Trend[0] < 0 (bearish signal appears) and BuyPosClose permission is true
Short position closed when Trend[0] > 0 (bullish signal appears) and SellPosClose permission is true

params.description: MM=-0.1 means fixed 0.1 lot; positive values represent deposit fraction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: if MM < 0 then fixed lot = abs(MM), else deposit fraction = MM

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a custom ColorBullsBearsEyes indicator which is an EMA-smoothed bulls/bears power oscillator with configurable algorithm modes (twist=direction change, breakdown1=middle line crossover, breakdown2=overbought/oversold level breakout, breakdown3=exit+breakout). Buffer index 2 provides discrete trend signals: +2=strong buy, +1=mild buy, -1=mild sell, -2=strong sell. Only +2/-2 trigger entries; +1/-1 only trigger opposite exits. SignalBar=1 means signal is read from the previous completed bar. The AlgMode enum controls the indicator's internal signal generation logic. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose helper functions and CIsNewBar class.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the ColorBullsBearsEyes indicator logic in Python. The indicator is a smoothed bulls/bears power ratio with gamma smoothing. Bulls Power = High - EMA(close, period); Bears Power = Low - EMA(close, period). The Eyes variant computes a normalized ratio and applies gamma EMA smoothing. Buffer 2 outputs discrete trend codes (+2, +1, -1, -2) based on the selected AlgMode. For breakdown2 mode: +2 when indicator crosses above HighLevel, -2 when crosses below LowLevel. Also need to reimplement TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions for position sizing (MM negative=fixed lot, positive=deposit fraction), order execution with deviation, and the CIsNewBar new-bar detection class.
